name: Berth marshal
design: Very tall muscular male, charcoal skin with subdued copper mottling, angular brow, exposed prominent mandibles and many long heavy dreadlocks. Layered sleeveless grey-black officer coat with broad copper shoulder clasps, dark sash and several cargo-key loops. Holds a short baton-shaped unlit directional beacon beside leg with no blade; left hand lightly touches wrist communicator. Open steady stance.
